statements.status_notes: Samba 4.22.10-r1 and 4.23.8-r1 include Samba's official 28 July 2026 security update, which adds missing CTDB packet bounds checks. Advisories: https://www.samba.org/samba/security/CVE-2026-58224.html and https://www.samba.org/samba/history/security.html. Patches: https://download.samba.org/pub/samba/patches/security/samba-4.22.10-security-2026-07-28.patch and https://download.samba.org/pub/samba/patches/security/samba-4.23.9-security-2026-07-28.patch (the 4.23.9 patch applies unchanged to the 4.23.8 tarball Alpine 3.24 still ships).
